description: Read third-party risk data: list vendors, one vendor, its research, assessments (list, one, latest, status), certifications, compensating controls, action items. Pick with method.

assessment_id.description: Assessment UUID — obtain from scf_list_vendor_assessments or the trigger response [assessment] | Assessment UUID — returned by scf_trigger_vendor_assessment [assessment_status] Used by: assessment, assessment_status.

criticality.description: Criticality tier filter Used by: list.

method.description:
list: List third-party vendors in the organization's TPRM (Third-Party Risk Management) registry. Optionally filter by status or criticality. Paginated.
get: Get one vendor's detail: certifications, assessments, computed risk score, and latest research results.
research: Get the latest vendor research result: breach history, known vulnerabilities, and security posture analysis. Poll this after scf_trigger_vendor_research.
list_assessments: List a vendor's AI security assessments, newest first. Includes status, RAG rating, recommendation, and report fields per record.
assessment: Get one vendor AI assessment by ID with full detail: services_used, data_role, RAG status, recommendation, full report fields, and research sources.
latest_assessment: Get a vendor's latest completed AI security assessment: RAG status, recommendation, executive summary, report_markdown/report_json. 404 if none completed yet.
assessment_status: Get the job status of a queued vendor AI assessment: status, started_at, completed_at, error_message. Poll this after scf_trigger_vendor_assessment.
certifications: List a vendor's certifications (read — viewer role): name, issuing body, certificate number, status, issue and expiry dates, scope and verification URL.
compensating_controls: List compensating controls recorded against a vendor's gaps (read — viewer): gap, offsetting control, effectiveness, notes. For the org's own controls use scf_list_org_compensating_controls.
action_items: List remediation action items for one vendor, or across every vendor when vendor_id is omitted (read — viewer role). Filter by status or priority.

per_page.description: Page size (1–100, default 25) Used by: list.

priority.description: Filter by priority Used by: action_items.

status.description: Lifecycle status filter — one of: prospect, active, under_review, approved, suspended, offboarded [list] | Filter by status [action_items] Used by: list, action_items.

vendor_id.description: Vendor UUID — obtain from scf_list_vendors [get, research, list_assessments, assessment, latest_assessment, assessment_status, certifications, compensating_controls] | Vendor UUID — omit to list action items across all vendors [action_items] Used by: get, research, list_assessments, assessment, latest_assessment, assessment_status, certifications, compensating_controls, action_items.

name: scf_vendor_read
